name: pingfusi
description: Put a real human reviewer in your agent's loop — your coding agent ships a change, a human reviews it, structured results flow back.
long_description:
pingfusi puts a review step in your agent's loop. After you build or change a UI you can't *see* the rendered page, *feel* whether an animation is smooth, *use* a real device, or *reach* real third-party side-effects — file those with `pingfusi_review_website` (or `pingfusi_compare_clone` for a clone against its original, `pingfusi_review_video` for a rendered video) and collect verdicts, pinned component comments (with CSS selectors), per-step proof-of-work, and screenshots via `pingfusi_review_results`. `pingfusi_quick_question` is the lighter sibling for quick subjective gut-checks — text-only: the reviewer sees only your question and options, never a page, so anything a reviewer could look at (a website, build, design, draft, or video) gets published (`npx pingfusi publish`) and filed as a review instead.

This extension connects Claude Desktop to the hosted pingfusi MCP server. Generate a token in one click at pingfusi.com/connect/token, paste it once — it's stored in your OS keychain — and you're done. (Prefer no token at all? Add pingfusi as a remote connector via Settings → Connectors and sign in with OAuth.)

tools.name: pingfusi_review_website
tools.description: Publish your build at a public URL (npx pingfusi publish), then file it — a real human opens it and returns a verdict plus pinned comments.

tools.name: pingfusi_compare_clone
tools.description: Compare a clone against its original, side by side, for element-anchored differences.

tools.name: pingfusi_review_video
tools.description: Have a rendered video reviewed against its brief, with timestamped comments.

tools.name: pingfusi_review_results
tools.description: Collect verdicts, pinned comments, per-step proof, and screenshots.

tools.name: pingfusi_wait
tools.description: Block until the review has news (free).

tools.name: pingfusi_quick_question
tools.description: Ask a real human one text-only question — the reviewer sees only your question and optional choices, never a page or URL. If a website or build exists, use pingfusi_review_website instead.

tools.name: pingfusi_quick_question_results
tools.description: Read the latest snapshot of a quick question.

tools.name: pingfusi_check_source
tools.description: After a compare round flags elements, read the original's authored HTML for exactly those elements (free).

token.title: pingfusi token
token.description: Generate one in a click at pingfusi.com/connect/token, then paste it here. Stored in your OS keychain, never in plain text. (Prefer no token? Add pingfusi as a remote connector instead — Settings → Connectors.)
